'''2023 Worlds Casey Anis DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2023 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Casey Anis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2023 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Hunt Down And Destroy The Je Anis D.txt |Download]]
